title: Selective Prediction Intervals: Jointly Learning to Predict, Bound, and Abstain
abstract: arXiv:2611.06158v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many high-stakes regression decisions ask three things of a model at once: a point estimate to act on, an interval that bounds the risk of acting, and the option to abstain when neither can be trusted. Deep learning provides these in isolation: prediction-interval methods return an interval, and at best a value estimate inside it, for every input, while selective-prediction methods learn when to abstain, but only for point predictions and with no statement of how far the truth may lie from the estimate. We introduce SelPI, which trains interval, value and abstention heads jointly under a single loss with an explicit acceptance-rate budget. A natural objection is that interval width already tells us when to abstain. We show that it does not: across 18 tabular benchmarks, width predicts large point errors well (AUROC 0.72) but is anti-correlated with interval misses (AUROC 0.38), so abstaining on wide intervals discards precisely the input

translated_title: 选择性预测区间：联合学习预测、界定与弃权
translated_abstract: 许多高风险的回归决策同时要求模型做三件事：一个可以据以行动的点估计、一个能够界定行动风险的区间，以及在两者都不可信时选择弃权的选项。深度学习只能孤立地提供这些能力：预测区间方法为每个输入返回一个区间（充其量再给出区间内的一个值估计），而选择性预测方法学习何时弃权，但仅针对点预测，且无法说明真实值与估计值可能相差多远。我们提出了SelPI，它在单一损失函数下以显式的接受率预算联合训练区间、值和弃权三个头。一个自然的质疑是，区间宽度本身已经能告诉我们何时该弃权。我们证明事实并非如此：在18个表格数据基准上，区间宽度能较好地预测大的点误差（AUROC 0.72），但与区间失误呈负相关（AUROC 0.38），因此基于宽区间进行弃权恰恰会丢弃那些……
tldr: 提出SelPI方法，在单一损失函数和显式接受率预算下联合训练预测值、区间和弃权三个头，并实证证明仅凭区间宽度无法可靠判断何时应当弃权。
en_tdlr: SelPI jointly trains value, interval, and abstention heads under a single loss with an explicit acceptance-rate budget, and shows empirically that interval width alone cannot reliably indicate when to abstain.
